pages.ja:
夜が明けようとしていた。
赤い外套の騎士は柱に背を預けたまま、ただ己が腕を見つめている。
指先に力を込め、広げた手のひらを握る。
感覚は、残り半分といったところだ。
いかに英霊と言えど、この世界に留まれる依り代がいなくては存在を保てない。
アーチャーのクラスが持つ特殊能力故に存命しているが、それも限界が見えている。

pages.en:
Dawn is drawing near.

The knight in red remains against the pillar, staring at his own arm.

He tightens his fingers, closing his outstretched hand.

Perhaps half its sensation remains.

Not even a Heroic Spirit can sustain a body in this world without a Master to serve as its anchor.

The special ability of the Archer class has kept him alive, but even that is approaching its limit.
pages.mirrorMoon:
It is daybreak.
The knight in red is leaning against a pillar and staring at his arm.
Putting strength into his fingers, he makes a fist.
His body is only half responding.
Even heroic spirits cannot maintain their existence in this world without their Masters.
He still exists because of the special class ability of Archer, but he’s almost at his limits.

pages.ja:
赤い騎士に残された力は、もはや元の一割にも満たない。
握りしめた拳は希薄であり、気を抜けば徐々に風化していくだろう。
pages.jaRuby:

握りしめた拳は希薄であり、気を抜けば徐々に風化していくだろう。
pages.en:
The knight in red possesses less than a tenth of his former strength.

The fist he clenches is insubstantial. If he relaxes his concentration, it will gradually erode into the air.
pages.mirrorMoon:
His remaining strength is not even a tenth of his original powers.
His muscles are weak, and his body will slowly disappear if he loses focus.

pages.ja:
「
」
だが問題はない。
残された力が十分の一に満たずとも、衛宮士郎を処刑するには十分だ。
標的との戦力差を考えれば、この程度のマイナスはハンデにすらなりえまい。
故に、戦闘になれば終わる。
彼にとって唯一つの目的となっていたモノが、ここで終わりを告げるのだ。

pages.en:
“————”

But there is no difficulty.

Less than a tenth of his power will still suffice to execute Shirou Emiya.

Given the difference in their strength, a disadvantage of this degree cannot even be called a handicap.

Thus, the moment battle begins, it will be over.

The single purpose that has come to define him will meet its end here.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
”
But there’s no problem.
Even if he has less than a tenth of his original power, it is enough to kill Emiya Shirou.
Considering the difference in their abilities, this isn’t even a handicap.
Therefore, it will end once they fight.
His one and only objective will be accomplished here.

pages.ja:
「
」
……そう。
彼は、この時だけを待ち続けてきた。
永遠に続く一瞬の繰り返しの中、この確率だけを希望にして耐えてきた。
限りなくゼロに近い確率、本来起こりえる筈のない希望を持つ事しか、彼には出来なかった。
pages.jaRuby:
「
」
……そう。
彼は、この時だけを待ち続けてきた。
永遠に続く一瞬の繰り返しの中、この確率だけを希望にして耐えてきた。
限りなくゼロに近い確率、本来起こりえる筈のない希望を持つ事しか、彼には出来なかった。
pages.en:
“————”

…Yes.

He has waited all this time for this one moment.

Amid an endless repetition of eternal instants, he endured by placing his hope in this one possibility.

It was a probability infinitesimally close to zero, a hope that by rights could never be realized—and he could do nothing but cling to it.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
”
…That’s right.
He has waited for this time.
He has endured the endless repetition hoping for this chance.
He has awaited a miracle that would not occur, a miracle with a probability close to zero.

pages.ja:
それが叶った。
いや、あと一押しで叶おうとしている。
……その後に待つものがなんであるかなど、彼にはもはやどうでもいい。
自らを自らの手で殺す。
その、希望というにはあまりにも未来のない願いだけが、摩耗しきった彼をここまで支えてきた物なのだから。

pages.en:
Now it has come to pass.

No—one final push remains before it does.

…He no longer cares what awaits him afterward.

To kill himself with his own hands.

That wish, too barren of any future to deserve the name of hope, is the one thing that sustained him after all else had worn away.
pages.mirrorMoon:
And his wish was granted.
No, it is about to be granted.
…He does not care what awaits him afterwards.
He will kill his own self with his own hands.
The hopeless, futureless wish is what kept him going after he wore out.

pages.ja:
「
長かったのか。それとも、刹那にすぎなかったのか」
元より呼び出されれば消える身。
それを何百、何千回と繰り返そうと、彼の記憶には残らない。
ただそんな事があった、と知識として大本に記録されるだけだ。
英霊たちがそれぞれ他の英霊を知るのは、そういった“召喚の蓄積”による知識を蓄えているからである。

pages.en:
“—Has it been long, I wonder? Or no more than an instant?”

From the moment he is summoned, his body is fated to disappear.

However many hundreds or thousands of times the process repeats, the experiences do not remain in his memory.

Only the knowledge that those events occurred is recorded in the original upon the Throne.

Heroic Spirits know of other Heroic Spirits because they accumulate the knowledge left by this succession of summons.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
Was it long? Or was it an instant?”
He is an existence that disappears after each summoning.
His memory does not remain, no matter how many times he repeats the cycle.
It only stays in his body as knowledge.
Heroic spirits recognize other heroic spirits because of these accumulated facts.

pages.ja:
言うなれば本と同じだ。
一度呼び出される度に、その歴史の本が家に送られてくる。
出かけた筈の自分は家にいて、送られてきた本を見るだけの存在だ。
厄介なのは、その本がいつ送られてきたものなのか、彼本人には判らないという事である。
pages.jaRuby:
言うなれば本と同じだ。
一度呼び出される度に、その歴史の本が家に送られてくる。
出かけた筈の自分は家にいて、送られてきた本を見るだけの存在だ。
厄介なのは、その本がいつ送られてきたものなのか、彼本人には判らないという事である。
pages.en:
It might be likened to a book.

Each time he is summoned, a volume chronicling that history is sent back to his home.

The self who supposedly traveled never left home at all. He exists only to read the books that return.

The difficulty is that he himself cannot know when any given book was sent.
pages.mirrorMoon:
It’s just like a book.
Every time a heroic spirit is summoned, the book with its story is sent to its home.
The heroic spirit itself remains in the house, reading those books.
The trouble is that the one at the house does not know when those books arrived.

pages.ja:
過去も未来も関係がない。
彼の部屋には初めから全ての『本』がある。
いずれ自身が成すであろう『掃除』の記録を読む事でしか、彼には時間を計る術がない。
pages.jaRuby:
過去も未来も関係がない。
彼の部屋には初めから全ての『本』がある。
いずれ自身が成すであろう『掃除』の記録を読む事でしか、彼には時間を計る術がない。
pages.en:
Past and future have no bearing there.

Every book has occupied his room from the beginning.

He can measure time only by reading the records of the “cleaning” he will someday perform.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Past or future do not matter.
All the “books” are already in his room.
His only way of measuring time is to read the records of his “cleaning” that he will accomplish.

pages.ja:
彼にとっては永遠も一瞬も変わらない。
永遠は一瞬であり、一瞬は永遠なのだ。
故に、この時間がどれほどの確率で掴んだ奇跡なのかも判らない。
その目的を得てから、真っ先に呼ばれた時が今なのか、目的を得てから何千回と繰り返した後が今なのか。
……彼に有るのは順序が狂った知識だけ。
未来も過去も現在も、英霊にとっては有って無い物なのである。
pages.jaRuby:
彼にとっては永遠も一瞬も変わらない。
永遠は一瞬であり、一瞬は永遠なのだ。
故に、この時間がどれほどの確率で掴んだ奇跡なのかも判らない。
その[ruby text=きぼう char=2]目的を得てから、真っ先に呼ばれた時が今なのか、目的を得てから何千回と繰り返した後が今なのか。
……彼に有るのは順序が狂った知識だけ。
未来も過去も現在も、英霊にとっては有って無い物なのである。
pages.en:
To him, eternity and an instant are indistinguishable.

Eternity is an instant, and an instant is eternity.

Thus he cannot know how improbable a miracle this moment represents.

Is this the very first time he has been summoned since acquiring that purpose—his hope? Or has he repeated the cycle thousands of times since then?

…All he possesses is knowledge thrown out of sequence.

For a Heroic Spirit, future, past, and present alike exist and do not exist.
pages.mirrorMoon:
It makes no difference if it’s eternal or instantaneous.
Eternity is instantaneous, and an instant is eternal.
Therefore, he does not know how rare this miracle is.
He does not know if this is the first time or the thousandth time since he obtained this hope.
…All he has is unordered knowledge.
Past, present, and future are meaningless for heroic spirits.

pages.ja:
「……来客か。邪魔は入らんというから来てやったのだがな」
不意に、赤い騎士は身を起こした。
その耳が侵入者の音を聞いたのか。
無音の筈の城に、段々と足音が響き出す。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“…A visitor. I was assured there would be no interference when I agreed to come here.”

Abruptly, the knight in red straightens.

Perhaps his ears have caught the sound of an intruder.

Footsteps begin to echo through the castle that should have been silent.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…A guest, huh? I chose this place because I was told there would be no interruptions here.”
The knight in red suddenly gets up.
Did his ears hear the sound of the intruder?
Footsteps echo through the silent castle.

pages.ja:
「
へえ。驚きだね遠坂。半信半疑だったけど、ほんとにこんな所にいたんだ」
声が響く。
無遠慮に足を踏み入れたのは、間桐慎二という少年だった。
pages.jaRuby:
「
へえ。驚きだね遠坂。半信半疑だったけど、ほんとにこんな所にいたんだ」

pages.en:
“—Well. I'm impressed, Tohsaka. I wasn't sure I believed it, but you really are here.”

A voice rings through the room.

The boy who strolls in without the slightest reserve is Shinji Matou.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
Wow. I’m surprised, Tohsaka. I was dubious, but you really are here.”
A voice echoes.
The rude intruder is a boy called Matou Shinji.

pages.ja:
「おっと、物騒な真似はなしだぜアーチャー。
こっちはおまえに用はないんだ。おまえだって遠坂に用はないんだろ？ ならここで殺し合うコトはないんじゃない？」
間桐慎二は軽い足取りで歩いてくる。
その視線の先には、椅子に縛られた遠坂凛の姿があった。
少女は何も言わず、椅子に縛られたままで闖入者を睨み付ける。
それが悦に入ったのか。
満足げに唇を舐めて、間桐慎二は少女へと近づいていく。

pages.en:
“Whoa there. No need for violence, Archer.

“I'm not here for you. And you don't have any use for Tohsaka, do you? Then there's no reason for us to kill each other here, is there?”

Shinji Matou advances with a spring in his step.

His gaze is fixed upon Rin Tohsaka, bound to the chair.

The girl says nothing. Still tied in place, she glares at the intruder.

Perhaps her hatred pleases him. Licking his lips in satisfaction, Shinji Matou approaches her.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Oh, don’t do anything violent, okay?
I don’t have any business with you. You have no business with Tohsaka either, right? Then isn’t it meaningless for us to fight here?”
Matou Shinji walks forward with light steps.
He is looking at Tohsaka, who is tied up.
The girl glares silently at the intruder.
That must delight him.
He licks his lips in satisfaction and walks to the girl.

「あ？」

「なに、やるっていうの？ 本気かよ、おまえなんて相手になるワケないじゃんか！」
口元を吊り上げ、間桐慎二は入り口に振り返る。

pages.en:
“————”

“Huh?”

Finding the silent knight looking down upon him, Shinji Matou shoots him an irritated glance.

“What, you want to fight? Are you serious? There's no way someone like you could take him!”

His mouth curling upward, Shinji Matou looks back toward the entrance.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
”
“What?”
Stared down by the knight, Matou Shinji looks up in annoyance.
“What, you want to fight me? Are you serious? You’d be no match for me!”
He smiles and turns back to the entrance.

pages.ja:
現れたものは金の髪をした青年
第八のサーヴァント、ギルガメッシュ。
それは、一つの災厄だった。
黄金のサーヴァントは涼しげに赤い騎士を眺めている。
だがその奥。
笑いに歪む赤い瞳には、目前の敵を惨殺する意思しかない。

pages.en:
The figure who appears is a golden-haired young man—Gilgamesh, the eighth Servant.

He is calamity given form.

The golden Servant regards the knight in red with apparent composure.

—But beneath it—

His crimson eyes are twisted with laughter and contain nothing but the will to butcher the enemy before him.
pages.mirrorMoon:
There stands a man with golden hair
the eighth Servant, Gilgamesh.
He is, literally, a disaster.
The golden Servant looks at the knight with cool eyes.
But within them…
The red eyes only show the intent to brutally kill the enemy in front of him.

」

間桐慎二が現れようと、目前に最強のサーヴァントが牙を研いでいようと変わらない。
騎士は泰然としたまま、招かれざる敵を見据えている。
pages.jaRuby:

」

pages.en:
“————”

The knight in red remains silent.

Shinji Matou's appearance changes nothing. Neither does the sight of the strongest Servant sharpening his fangs before him.

Perfectly composed, the knight meets the gaze of his uninvited enemy.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
”
The knight in red is still silent.
It makes no difference even if Matou Shinji appears or if the strongest Servant is ready to attack him.
The knight calmly stares at the uninvited enemies.

」
「
凛が欲しいのか、間桐慎二」
「え……？ あ、ああ、当然じゃないか。そうでもなけりゃこんな城には近寄らないよ」

pages.en:
“Ha! Shaking in your boots, Archer? That's nothing to be ashamed of. He's the Servant who disposed of Berserker without breaking a sweat. Of course someone like you would lose his nerve—”

“—You want Rin, Shinji Matou?”

“Huh…? Y-yeah, obviously. Why else would I come anywhere near this castle?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Haha. You’re scared, right? It’s nothing to be ashamed of. He even killed Berserker. It’s natural for you to be scar
”
“
Do you want Rin, Matou Shinji?”
“Huh…? Y-Yeah, of course. There’s no other reason for me to come to this castle.”

pages.ja:
「そうか。ならばコトが済むまで待て。衛宮士郎を始末した後ならばくれてやる。
それまで、アレは私の物だ。それが聞けぬとあれば仕方がない。
不本意だが、ここで死ぬ事になるぞギルガメッシュ」
金色のサーヴァントを見据えたまま、赤い騎士はそう告げた。
pages.jaRuby:
「そうか。ならばコトが済むまで待て。衛宮士郎を始末した後ならばくれてやる。

不本意だが、ここで死ぬ事になるぞギルガメッシュ」
金色のサーヴァントを見据えたまま、赤い騎士はそう告げた。
pages.en:
“I see. Then wait until my business is concluded. Once I have disposed of Shirou Emiya, I will give her to you.

“Until then, she belongs to me. If you refuse, you leave me no choice. —Reluctant though I am, you will die here, Gilgamesh.”

The knight in red delivers the warning without taking his eyes from the golden Servant.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I see. Then wait until this is over. I will give her to you after I kill Emiya Shirou.
She is mine until then. It cannot be helped if you cannot compromise on that.
It will be regrettable, but you will die here, Gilgamesh.”
The knight’s eyes remain on the golden Servant as he speaks.

pages.ja:
「愉快だな、道化」
その発言ですら、男にとっては死に値するのか。
金色のサーヴァントは目前の赤い騎士を、決して見逃さぬ抹消対象として認識した。
pages.jaRuby:
「愉快だな、道化」
その発言ですら、男にとっては死に値するのか。
金色のサーヴァントは目前の赤い騎士を、決して見逃さぬ抹消対象として認識した。
pages.en:
“You are amusing, clown.”

Perhaps even that declaration is enough to merit death in the man's eyes.

The golden Servant marks the knight in red as a thing to be erased—one he will never permit to escape.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Very funny, you fool.”
Were those words reason enough for the man to kill Archer?
The golden Servant identifies the knight in front of him as a target he must kill.

pages.ja:
「待てギルガメッシュ。はやまるなよ、事はスマートに行こう。いいじゃん、くれるってんだから貰っておこう。
どうせアーチャーはマスターがいないんだ。何度も裏切ったコイツと契約するマスターなんていないんだしさ、ほっとけば消えるんだろ。遠坂はその後で貰えばいい」
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Hold on, Gilgamesh. Don't do anything rash. Let's handle this neatly. He's offering her to us, so why not take him up on it?

“Archer has no Master anyway. No Master would make a contract with someone who's betrayed people as many times as he has. Leave him alone and he'll disappear, won't he? We can take Tohsaka afterward.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Hold on, Gilgamesh. Don’t be rash, and let’s be smart. Come on, he says he’s going to give her to me, so I’ll let him.
Archer doesn’t have a Master. I’m sure no Master would make a contract with a Servant that betrayed so many people, so he’ll disappear if we let him be. I can take Tohsaka after that.”

pages.ja:
口元を吊り上げたまま、間桐慎二は赤い騎士を睨め付ける。
その目は、あと数刻で消えようとする者の末路を愉しんでいるようだった。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
His lips still curled, Shinji Matou glares at the knight in red.

His eyes seem to savor the fate awaiting a man who will vanish within a matter of hours.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Matou Shinji smiles and stares at the knight in red.
It looks as if he is enjoying the fate of the one who is about to disappear.

pages.ja:
「賢明だな、間桐慎二。その判断は的確だ。君はある意味、誰よりもマスターに相応しい」
「なんだ、アンタ見所あるじゃん！ もったいない、それなら僕のところに来てれば契約してやったのに！」
赤い騎士から離れ、心底愉快げに間桐慎二は両手を叩く。
pages.jaRuby:
「賢明だな、間桐慎二。その判断は的確だ。君はある意味、誰よりもマスターに相応しい」
「なんだ、アンタ見所あるじゃん！ もったいない、それなら僕のところに来てれば契約してやったのに！」
赤い騎士から離れ、心底愉快げに間桐慎二は両手を叩く。
pages.en:
“Wise, Shinji Matou. Your judgment is sound. In one respect, you are more suited to be a Master than anyone.”

“Huh, so you know talent when you see it! What a waste. If you'd come to me, I might have made a contract with you!”

Moving away from the knight in red, Shinji Matou claps his hands in wholehearted delight.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“You’re smart, Matou Shinji. That’s an intelligent decision. You are a most fitting Master, in a sense.”
“Oh, you show promise! How wasteful! I would’ve made a contract with you if you came to me!”
Stepping away from the knight, Matou Shinji claps his hands happily.

pages.ja:
「けど悪いね、もう他のサーヴァントなんて要らないんだ。残念だけどさ、おとなしく消えちゃってよ、アンタ」
「言われるまでもない。それで、結局どうするのだ。ここで私と戦うか、私が消え去るのを待つのか」
pages.jaRuby:
「けど悪いね、もう他のサーヴァントなんて要らないんだ。残念だけどさ、おとなしく消えちゃってよ、アンタ」
「言われるまでもない。それで、結局どうするのだ。ここで私と戦うか、私が消え去るのを待つのか」
pages.en:
“But sorry—I don't need another Servant now. It's a shame, but why don't you go quietly and disappear?”

“You need not tell me. So what will you do? Fight me here, or wait for me to vanish?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“But I’m sorry. I don’t need any more Servants. It’s unfortunate, but you’ll have to disappear.”
“You do not need to tell me. So what will you do? Will you fight me, or wait until I disappear?”

pages.ja:
「ああ、待ってやるよ。衛宮を始末するまで、遠坂は僕たちが守ってやろうじゃないか。
けど、そうだな。となると、アレはもう僕のだろ？ なら何をしても構わないと思わない？」
pages.jaRuby:
「ああ、待ってやるよ。衛宮を始末するまで、遠坂は僕たちが守ってやろうじゃないか。
けど、そうだな。となると、アレはもう僕のだろ？ なら何をしても構わないと思わない？」
pages.en:
“Oh, we'll wait. Until you've disposed of Emiya, we'll be generous enough to protect Tohsaka for you.

“But let's see. That means she's mine already, doesn't it? And if she's mine, I can do whatever I want with her. Wouldn't you agree?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Yeah, I’ll wait. We’ll protect Tohsaka until you kill Emiya.
But, yeah. That thing is mine already, right? Then I can do anything to her, right?”

pages.ja:
毒蛇じみた視線は、赤い騎士と遠坂凛に向けられたものだ。
赤い騎士の忠誠を試す言葉。
それに、
「
傷をつけるな、というのが衛宮士郎との契約だが、それは夜明けとともに消える。刻限がきたのなら、後は好きにするがいい」
感情のない声で、赤い騎士は返答した。

pages.en:
His viper's gaze shifts between the knight in red and Rin Tohsaka.

The words are a test of the knight's loyalty.

And to them—

“My agreement with Shirou Emiya forbids any harm to her, but that condition expires at dawn. Once the appointed hour has passed, you may do as you please.”

The knight in red answers without emotion.
pages.mirrorMoon:
He stares at the knight and Tohsaka Rin with snake-like eyes.
His words are to test the loyalty of the knight.
To that…
“
I have promised Emiya Shirou that she will not be harmed. But that promise is over at dawn. You can do as you wish when the time comes.”
The knight in red replies in an emotionless voice.

はは、あははははははははははは！
聞いたかよ遠坂、おまえのサーヴァント、マスターを売っぱらうってさ！」
薄汚れた室内に嘲笑が響き渡る。
関心などない、と赤い騎士は部屋を後にした。

pages.en:
“Ha—haha, ahahahahahahahaha!

“Hear that, Tohsaka? Your own Servant says he's selling his Master off!”

His mockery echoes through the filthy chamber.

As though none of it concerns him, the knight in red leaves the room.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ha
Haha, hahahahahahahahahaha!
Did you hear that, Tohsaka!? Your Servant is selling off his Master!”
Sneering laughter echoes in the dirty room.
The knight exits as if he’s not interested.
